title: amellus discoideus
intro: Amellus discoideus, commonly known as  the Rock Rose or  Rock Cress, is a perennial plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Amellus discoideus include its ability to soothe and calm skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
